With this package you can deliver one extra day of production (24 hours) to your active planet or moon storages.

The 24 hours are calculated from the moment you use the item, not from the purchase time.

Production from all your planets is summed. Negative production reduces the result. If the total is below #amount#, you will receive this minimum amount.

If your daily production exceeds free storage space, the excess production is lost.

Additional rule (OGame Mobile only):
When an event is active, OGame Mobile allows activating resources above the normal storage cap. In this case there is no overflow loss: extra resources are credited in full. A symbol on the item indicates that an event is active and over-cap storage is available.
